_comment: LEVEL 4 (component): threaded in-process task queue with retry + dead-letter handling.
name: comp-queue-worker
description: Task queue worker: threaded executor, retry with backoff, dead-letter on final failure. Import: from {{ utils_dir }}.queue_worker import TaskQueue
notes: Usage: q = TaskQueue(); q.submit(fn, arg=1); q.wait() to drain. Retries (default 3) with backoff; final failures go to on_dead callback. In-process only — swap to Celery/RQ when you outgrow one process.
